determinacy.why: A single-laureate rule forces the 1962 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine down to one of its three laureates without saying which: Watson, Crick and Wilkins are equally good candidates.

assumes: James Watson received the 1962 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
worlds.summary: Watson keeps the prize; Crick and Wilkins lose it.

assumes: Maurice Wilkins received the 1962 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
worlds.summary: Wilkins keeps the prize; Watson and Crick lose it.
